1.question: Can I migrate from my current POS?
1.answer: Yes! Matbex integrates with all major POS systems including Square, Toast, Clover, and Lightspeed. Our onboarding team will handle the data migration, typically completed within 48 hours with zero downtime.

2.question: How does Matbex handle offline modes?
2.answer: Matbex uses local-first architecture. All critical operations (sales, clock-ins, inventory counts) work offline and sync automatically when connectivity is restored. Your restaurant never stops, even if the internet does.

3.question: Is my data encrypted?
3.answer: Absolutely. We use AES-256 encryption at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit. Your data is stored in SOC 2 Type II certified data centers with daily backups. We are also GDPR and CCPA compliant.

4.question: What kind of support do you offer?
4.answer: Essentials plans include email support with 24-hour response times. Pro plans get priority support with live chat during business hours. Enterprise customers receive a dedicated account manager and 24/7 phone support.

5.question: Can I try before I buy?
5.answer: Yes! Every plan includes a 14-day free trial with full feature access. No credit card required to start. If you need more time to evaluate, just reach out and we are flexible.

6.question: How accurate is the COGS tracking?
6.answer: Our customers typically see theoretical vs. actual variance within 0.5%. The system tracks every ingredient from receiving to plate, accounting for waste, comps, and portion variations. Most operators identify 3-5% in hidden costs within the first month.
